title: A recovery spell shorter than the timelock cannot be vetoed
description: If a spell has a delay below the timelock delay, the owners have no time to remove it through a proposal, and the guardian has no say over it. Which delay suits a wallet depends on whom its user trusts, so this stays a choice in the configuration and is accepted.

title: Compromised cold signers can act with no spell or guardian set
description: With neither a recovery spell nor a guardian in place, nothing stands between stolen cold keys and the wallet. A user who wants that protection sets them up.

title: Transfers of fee-charging tokens may move a different amount
description: The timelock does no accounting and does not read what a token call returned, so a token that takes a fee can send more or less than was asked. Accepted.
